purpose: Past/Present/Future evidence snapshot for the authority-consolidation walkthrough that must close before a binding planning session or any masterplan execution-wave dispatch.

live git/GitHub protected-PR and oya-ci-required evidence

authority_consolidation: Masterplan v2 absorbed former sequencing, planning-closure, roadmap, harness, and Hermes planning surfaces; those sources remain provenance or evidence inputs, not parallel live plan authorities.
ADR-0363 retired the bespoke Oya VCS claim/verify/done/promote ratchet in favor of isolated git worktrees and protected GitHub pull requests.
ADR-0515 retired the pre-cutover CI backbone and made the single protected oya-ci-required context the admission target.
The zero-based masterplan v2 sequencing was founder-ratified on 2026-07-02 before any execution-wave dispatch.

sequencing_ratification.scope_limit: The ratification binds only dependency_edges, sequencing.work_item_order, and execution_waves work_item_ids. It does not ratify later authority choices, admit the current candidate, or authorize dispatch while the pre-planning contract is open.

repository_baseline.baseline_relation: HEAD equals origin/dev before the candidate is committed
repository_baseline.claim_ceiling: This snapshot and its companion edits are a local PR candidate. They are not accepted authority, merge evidence, planning completion, product completion, or wave-dispatch authority.

guardrails: Accepted and Amended ADRs bind planning; Proposed and conditional ADRs do not.

A higher ADR number is only more recent, not automatically more authoritative. A later contradiction displaces an earlier Accepted decision only when the later ADR is itself Accepted and explicitly amends or supersedes the earlier decision with reciprocal lifecycle propagation.
When a Proposed ADR conflicts with an Accepted ADR, the Accepted ADR remains binding and the conflict becomes a founder choice.
Implementation already present in the tree, autonomous-delegation prose, or a body statement that a choice was made does not silently promote frontmatter lifecycle status.

Any still-present superseded or deprecated ADR is nonbinding historical data only; its continued presence is implementation drift against ADR-0515's current hard-delete rule and cannot be mistaken for live authority or an amendment.

hermes_claim_tiers.claim_rule: Hermes done-column state is a completion claim only. Evidence attachment is a mechanical cross-reference and never upgrades masterplan_status to verified or done.

remaining_gaps.required_evidence: The live oya-ci-required producer and gate catalog execute from trusted trunk/controller state rather than candidate bytes.
Candidate code is data under test and cannot modify or delete its own required producer, gate catalog, branch-protection mapping, or runner isolation.
All remaining oya CLI references are retired or demonstrably local/advisory only; no CLI result becomes protected merge or Phase-0 exit authority.
Required pull-request reviews, admin enforcement, and required signatures are live or an explicit Accepted replacement contract is proven.
A controller-enforced override packet requires TTL, reviewer acknowledgment, audit event, owner, blast radius, and revert/fix follow-up.
Every candidate receives a result bundle conforming to specs/phase0-ci-enforcement-result-schema.json and the protected context is posted from trusted state.

Tenant A/B negative fixtures pass through the live required context across identity, secrets, runners, workspaces, caches, artifacts, logs/evidence, release ledgers, deploy targets, status callbacks, and audit events.

walkthrough_order: Confirm the authority order and the historical systems that are now provenance only.
Review the present evidence ceilings: baseline, ADR lifecycle counts, Hermes claim tiers, and Phase-0 gaps.
Resolve every founder choice marked blocks_binding_plan, and explicitly scope or defer any other Proposed ADR the plan would use.
Admit this consolidation through an isolated signed commit, protected PR against dev, independent review, resolved threads, no conflicts, and green oya-ci-required.
Close planning_entry_contract with evidence; only then begin binding plan approval and later execution-wave dispatch.
planning_entry_conditions: Supported ADR lifecycle metadata reflects every founder choice and reciprocal amendment/supersession links.
No Proposed ADR is used as binding authority.

Phase-0 open gaps remain explicit and no readiness claim exceeds live evidence.
The masterplan sequencing digest remains the ratified value or carries a fresh founder ratification.
No execution wave dispatched while the pre-planning contract was open.
